positions.as_written: Measure on a standing long leg film, because the reference is the limb's mechanical axis.
Compare with the perpendicular to the mechanical axis rather than to the film edge.
Say that the joint line definition must be stated.
The position worth holding is that obliquity should be measured, its definition stated, and its source located before a correction is planned.
